facts.text: The hotel is built on the cliff face of an abandoned quarry 88 meters below sea level.
facts.excerpt: the hotel is built on the cliff face of an abandoned quarry 88 meters below sea level

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as the world's first luxury hotel constructed inside a quarry.
facts.excerpt: It is the world’s first luxury hotel constructed inside a quarry.

facts.text: The hotel was honored as one of the Top 10 Architectural Wonders of the World by National Geographic's Megastructures.
facts.excerpt: Honored as one of the "Top 10 Architectural Wonders of the World" by National Geographic’s Megastructures.

facts.text: The hotel sits in the Sheshan Tourism Resort of Songjiang, Shanghai.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in the Sheshan Tourism Resort of Songjiang, Shanghai

facts.text: The hotel is 40 minutes from the Shanghai National Exhibition and Convention Center.
facts.excerpt: is 40 minutes from the Shanghai National Exhibition and Convention Center

facts.text: The lobby has a Subterranean Adventure theme, with bronze-colored walls that reproduce the layers of quarry rock.
facts.excerpt: The lobby takes "Subterranean Adventure" as its theme, with bronze-colored wall facades reproducing the natural appearance of quarry rock layers

facts.text: The Underwater View Suite may include an underwater view and a balcony.
facts.excerpt: Underwater View Suite may include: - Balcony - Underwater View

facts.text: The Duplex Suite may include an outdoor living area and an underwater view.
facts.excerpt: Duplex Suite may include: - Balcony - Outdoor Living Area - Underwater View

facts.text: Guest rooms have a 55-inch LCD TV, a JBL sound system, a separate shower and bathtub, and Dyson hair dryers.
facts.excerpt: equipped with 55-inch LCD TV,JBL audio player and sound system, separate shower bathtub and branded bath products. Dyson hair dryers

facts.text: The indoor pool offers views of the waterfall.
facts.excerpt: The pool offers views of the waterfall

facts.text: The indoor pool is heated.
facts.excerpt: Water type: Heated pool

facts.text: Mr. Fisher, a seafood restaurant one floor below the water level, is surrounded by a custom-built display of swimming sea creatures.
facts.excerpt: Located one floor below the water level, this specialty seafood venue is enveloped in a sea of water creatures swimming about in a custom built display.

facts.text: The Quarry Bar sits between the bottom of the quarry and the water.
facts.excerpt: The Ouarry Bar is located between the bottom of the quarry and the water.

facts.text: The Quarry Bar serves premium Scotch and spirits over stone-shaped quarry ice balls.
facts.excerpt: Our selection of premium Scotch and spirits can be savored on the rocks with the bar’s stone shaped “quarry” ice balls.

facts.text: From the She Shan Lounge Lobby Bar guests can take in the Sheshan National Scenic Area and the deep pits of Tianma Mountain.
facts.excerpt: At the She Shan Lounge Lobby Bar, you can enjoy the beauty of Sheshan National Scenic Area and the deep pits of Tian ma Mountain.

facts.text: Cai Feng Lou Chinese Restaurant has a motif drawn from traditional Chinese bird-keeping culture and serves Zhejiang and Guangdong specialties.
facts.excerpt: Cai Feng Lou Chinese Restaurant boasts a thematically unique motif representing traditional Chinese bird keeping culture.

facts.text: The hotel's spa, Sheng Spa, offers hydrotherapy.

facts.text: The hotel offers pickleball.
facts.excerpt: The trendy sport pickleball has arrived at the hotel.

facts.text: Commune, the buffet restaurant, has a separate children's play area.
facts.excerpt: A separate children's play area provides a delightful experience for our youngest guests.
